text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, fluttering in the breeze... ♪
Teehee,
your leaves have really grown a
lot. And you're so
big now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Back again, Bright? No matter how many
times
you come to look at them, those
flowers won't
bloom until next month.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello, Air Groove. And I don't
mind in the
slightest. ♪ You said the
very same thing the last
time I was here,
and I've not forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I might have known that you'd want to
watch
over that flowerbed from start to
finish.
Apparently, it's going to rain
soon, though, so do
come inside before
it does.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. I shall be done with today's
observation
before then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Dober was right—your patience is

unrivaled. I imagine if that flower were a
fawn lily,
you'd just as happily wait the
seven or eight years
to see it bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I imagine I would. For the beauty of
its full
blossom would be worth the wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And just as these flowers are blessed
with a
wonderful steward in you, Air
Groove, my dear
trainer watches over my
own growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My efforts will most definitely bear fruit
in the
form of results this year. Even if an
opponent
were to finish before me in
one race, I would go
on to best them
brilliantly in the next.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You've found quite a worthy
caretaker,
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. One who is trustworthy and has
the skill
to nurture any bud into a bright,
noble flower. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, Mejiro Bright informs
me that
the flowerbed has bloomed and
invites me to the
garden to see it with
her.
